plan.title: Pin-mismatch recovery guidance follows the settled failure-shaped map

narratives.Description: When package.json pin and installed node_modules disagree, hooks fail closed and print AC9.7 global install plus repair. Settled OVPR (#5798, AC9.12) says project package-manager install is the fix for that skew; repair is for deposits after the pin is installed.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Update install-health cheap/constants guidance and hook-dispatch printing so pin≠installed names project npm/pnpm install when only node_modules lags, and names repair only when deposits lag a good pin.
2. Add focused tests proving the guidance cases and that ordinary shells stay fail-closed; do not revive #5956 allow-list mega-design.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent or human after a pin bump, I want the mismatch refusal to tell me to run a project package-manager install, so that I can sync node_modules without a useless global reinstall.

items.title: Project PM install guidance on pin≠installed

narrative.Acceptance: Given pin says W and node_modules still has V, when a hooked shell is refused, then recovery text names project npm/pnpm install (frozen-lockfile when appropriate) and does not lead with global AC9.7 reinstall.
Given the same mismatch, when an ordinary non-recovery shell runs under the hook, then it remains fail-closed and no #5956-style install/repair allow-list mega-design is introduced.

expected_outputs: cheap and hook-dispatch tests pass for failure-shaped pin-mismatch guidance
